# EntLogoRows6

Partner wall organised by category.

## When to use it

A partner roster where which category a logo sits in matters as much as its being there.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | H-entities |
| Form | logo-wall |
| Arity | 6 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | standard, about 420 characters |
| Media | logo |
| Focal | logo at 26px against a 64px headline (ratio 0.4) |

## Why it holds together

Deliberately low. No single logo is the point; the grid of them is. A hero logo here would break the claim that these are peers within a category.

## Related kit layout

`LogoWallV1` — LogoWallV1 puts tiles in a fixed grid on the left half and leaves the right half empty. This is a table, not a grid, and it uses the canvas. Do not retire v1 until this has been through a real deck.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| logo art | real partner wordmarks | text placeholders | Logos are supplied per deck and inlined at fill time (§2a). Shipping a fixed set in the template would date it and bloat every deck that used it. |
| background density | 0.93 | 0.95 | Same cause: 27 real logos are dense art, 27 text wordmarks are not. Re-measure on a filled deck before treating this as a composition defect. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.

## Origin

Traced from `bank:36` and shipped as canon template `ent-logo-rows-6`. In the repository its template, `wpp-es-html-deck/canon/templates/ent-logo-rows-6.html`, is refreshed from this card's preview, and its trace sources (spec, measurements and reference image) are in `authoring/canon-src/ent-logo-rows-6/`.

# EntPartnerCredentials3

Partner credentials compared side by side.

## When to use it

Two or three partnerships, each with its own proof and client roster, all of them strong.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | H-entities (secondary D-quantitative) |
| Form | kpi-grid |
| Arity | 3 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | dense, about 880 characters |
| Media | logo |
| Focal | value at 36px against a 64px headline (ratio 0.56) |

## Why it holds together

Low on purpose. Twelve claims sharing a canvas cannot each be a display moment; the column structure carries the emphasis instead of any one figure.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| value overrun | ENTERPRISE collides with its body text, twice | wraps cleanly | A defect in the source, not a style. |
| background density | 0.87 | 0.90 | Real partner logos are dense black artwork; this template ships thin text wordmarks because logos are supplied per deck. The composition check counts pixels, so the placeholder reads emptier than the filled slide will. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.

## Origin

Traced from `bank:37` and shipped as canon template `ent-partner-credentials-3`. In the repository its template, `wpp-es-html-deck/canon/templates/ent-partner-credentials-3.html`, is refreshed from this card's preview, and its trace sources (spec, measurements and reference image) are in `authoring/canon-src/ent-partner-credentials-3/`.

# EntTeamRow6

Who is in the room.

## When to use it

Four to six people placed by role and location at the top of a meeting. Not biographies.

## Shape

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | H-entities |
| Form | team-grid |
| Arity | 6 |
| Ground | cream |
| Density | standard, about 540 characters |
| Media | photo |
| Focal | portrait at 220px against a 64px headline (ratio 3.4) |

## Why it holds together

Diameter against headline size. The faces are the slide; the headline only frames them, which is why a centred caps headline can sit above them without competing.

## Deviations from the traced source

| What | Source | Here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| name wrapping | wraps mid-name onto two lines | one line, enforced | The source's portraits are wide enough to hold the names; the wrap is a defect, not a style. |

## What the consumer supplies

Copy only. The geometry is measured off a real slide, so when you rebuild it in Claude Design Slides keep the positions and sizes in the preview exactly: change the words, not the grid. Build the text and shapes from the Elements cards, each of which ends with its Slides recipe.
